interface.longDescription: Help residents, immigrants, expats, and citizens navigate life in Poland with dated official-source metadata, non-identifying questions, deterministic checklists, plain-language terminology, locality-aware routing, and visible freshness warnings. Focused skills cover residence, EU mobility, identity, work, tax, ZUS, healthcare, housing, business, family, education, benefits, transport, consumer rights, foreign documents, digital government, local offices, protection, appeals, and emergencies. The offline CLI and read-only MCP server never log in, inspect personal records, submit, send, book, pay, upload, download, sign, or change external state, even with consent.
